authority_blockers.reason: P2 high-level semantics and Core tables are frozen, but exact factor/reference/cohort representation, identifiability/reason codes, uncertainty object, model/spec identities, cross-layer DTO projection and Release/evidence binding require machine-authority closure before dependent implementation may claim completion.

batches.name: P2 authority + immutable input / factor-reference-cohort substrate
Product presentation + parity + M7 rolling-design runway

tasks.minimum_acceptance: Versioned machine authority freezes exact factor feature-spec identity/version, reference-condition and cohort/specification representation, attribution/model-plugin identity, identifiability statuses/reason codes including NOT_IDENTIFIABLE, uncertainty semantics, knowledge-time/leakage rules, P2 DTO/application projection and immutable Release/evidence binding; implementation-local substitutes are forbidden.

tasks.deliverable: C4 P2 admission / feature-gate claim guard
tasks.minimum_acceptance: P2 remains dormant and externally unclaimable until protected-main M6 Exit GO; P1 remains the immutable observed-fact layer; P3-P6 remain inactive and unavailable behind fail-closed feature gates.

tasks.deliverable: Immutable P1 observation eligibility projection for P2
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Select only published immutable P1 observations with exact Release, metric semantic/version, subject/configuration, context, quality, evidence and comparison identity; historical interpretation uses frozen refs and never current/latest fallback.

Materialize versioned factor/context feature view, exact reference condition and comparable cohort/specification from governed authority; cohort minimum dimensions and evidence-independence accounting are explicit; missing governed inputs fail closed.

Every P2 input is checked against information-available/as-of time; future information and same-episode leakage are rejected; raw record count, observation count, independent subject count and effective evidence volume remain distinct.

Create deterministic assessment.factor_feature_set products bound to source P1 observation, feature spec/version, governed factor values, missing mask, World refs, coverage/confidence and exact input hash; no P1 mutation.

Execute only adopted attribution spec/model-plugin versions against exact governed dataset snapshot/reference condition; persist diagnostics/artifact identity and provenance sufficient for replay; association/model-conditioned contributions are not labeled causal without independent causal evidence.

Identifiability gate emits governed status/reason evidence and treats NOT_IDENTIFIABLE as a valid non-error product state; insufficient independence/coverage/conditioning fails closed without fabricating an adjusted value.

tasks.deliverable: Context-adjusted estimate + uncertainty / residual / factor effects
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Publish exact P2 adjusted estimate or governed status with reference condition, factor effects/candidate contributions, unexplained component/residual, uncertainty, claim level, evidence and version; adjusted output is a separate immutable product and never overwrites source P1 observation.

UI presents P1 observed fact and P2 adjusted/attributed estimate as visibly distinct products with exact Release/version/reference condition; status such as NOT_IDENTIFIABLE is distinct from zero, failure, N/A or insufficient data.

tasks.deliverable: P2 attribution evidence / uncertainty / diagnostics drill-down
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Evidence view exposes factor/reference/cohort identity, contribution labeling, uncertainty, residual/unexplained component, identifiability reasons, knowledge-time and exact provenance without implying unsupported causality.

During active M6 implementation, open/refine the M7/P3 design runway using actual P2 implementation evidence: Model Registry, applicability/OOD, independent validation, lifecycle/as-of semantics and Twin revision/release gaps are enumerated to task/interface/test level; no P3 implementation or claim is activated.

tasks.deliverable: P2 authority / admission / leakage Golden-negative suite
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Contract/negative tests fail closed on missing/mismatched P2 authority, stale spec/version, current/latest fallback, P2 pre-Exit claim, future information, same-episode leakage, P1 mutation and premature P3-P6 activation.

Synthetic fixtures cover nominal, missing-factor, low-coverage, non-comparable cohort, insufficient independent evidence and retrospective-knowledge cases with exact governed expected feature/reference/cohort identities.

Golden vectors verify adjusted value/status, factor effects/candidate contributions, residual, uncertainty and exact NOT_IDENTIFIABLE behavior; negative cases prove leakage rejection, unsupported causal labeling rejection and no adjusted-value fabrication.

tasks.deliverable: P2 cross-platform logical equivalence / replay / P1 non-regression
tasks.minimum_acceptance: One exact candidate proves Windows/Linux logical equivalence of P2 products, deterministic replay from frozen refs, immutable P1 hashes/Release membership, DB 1.6.0 compatibility and retained M5 security/performance/package/recovery gates.

tasks.deliverable: M6 Exit review and C4 P2 admission decision
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Exact 17/17 M6 evidence, C3 authority closure, factor/reference/cohort and leakage/identifiability/uncertainty gates, Golden/negative coverage, UI separation, cross-platform/replay/P1 non-regression and M7 design-runway evidence all pass with failed_acceptance=[]; only protected-main exact M6 Exit GO admits P2.
